Your compensation does not depend on whether you get the questions right or wrong, or on how fast you answer. 



The task is to find the correct answer on your own, without the aid of any calculation tools (including writing it down, please stick to mental calculations).

As soon as you proceed to the next page, your time for the first question will start.
